summary: Odisha has received 1,044.8 mm of rainfall since 1 June, 26% above normal, with Nabarangpur the only district still in deficit, at a point when all-India monsoon rainfall is running about 13% below the long-period average. summary: Gajapati district in southern Odisha recorded 121.6 mm of rainfall by the morning of Sunday 23 August after rain that began early on the Saturday, taking its cumulative total to 501.2 mm.
